turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Liew, the anesthesiologist who'll be taking care of you during your hernia surgery today. Let me go through some questions to make sure we're all set for your general anesthesia with the LMA. First, can you tell me a bit about your hernia and why you're having this surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, yes. This hernia on my left side has been bulging for almost a year now. It doesn't hurt much, but it gets uncomfortable when I lift heavy things or bend over. My surgeon said it's better to fix it before it gets worse, so here I am.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks for sharing that. Let's talk about your medications. I see you're on Metformin, Perindopril, Indapamide, and Atorvastatin. Are you still taking all of these as prescribed?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, all of them except Amlodipine. I stopped that one about six months ago because my ankles kept swelling up. My GP said it was due to the Amlodipine, so we switched me off it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I see. The records mentioned Amlodipine was still active, so I appreciate you correcting that. Did you have any other side effects from it besides the swelling?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, just the swelling. Blood pressure's been fine since I stopped it, though. My BP readings at the clinic have been pretty stable lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to know. Any allergies we should be aware of?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: None at all. Never had any reactions to medications or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Have you eaten or drunk anything this morning? Remember, it's important to be NPO for surgery.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing since midnight. Just a sip of water to take my morning pills, like the nurse instructed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Any previous surgeries or anesthesia experiences we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I had my appendix out when I was a teenager, but that's it. No problems with the anesthesia then.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Lastly, how's your overall fitness? Can you walk up a flight of stairs without getting short of breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yeah, no problem. I walk to the hawker center every day for lunch, and that's about 10 minutes. Only the hernia stops me from doing heavier stuff.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks for all the details, Mr. Tan. I'll update your records about the Amlodipine and make sure the team knows. Any questions or concerns before we proceed?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that's all. Just want to get this sorted and go back to my badminton games without pain lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Haha, sounds like a plan. We'll take good care of you. You'll meet the surgical team shortly, and I'll see you in the operating room.
